assertions.name: the_H3_Gram_matrix_is_ENTRYWISE_NONNEGATIVE
assertions.source: G = diag(y_lambda) with y = ['0.0', '0.247297886748', '0.505404226504']. All entries >= 0 (1 exactly zero -- the convention-D row cap y_lambda = 0 for l(lambda) > 2). Off-diagonal entries vanish by orthogonality of the central primitive idempotents

assertions.name: therefore_COORDINATE_POSITIVITY_IMPLIES_FROBENIUS_POSITIVITY_here
assertions.source: QOU.ParticleInteractions.frobPos_of_entriesNonneg (sorry-free) proves: G entrywise nonnegative implies CoordPos x -> FrobPos G x. With G = diag(y) and every y_lambda >= 0 the hypothesis holds, so in the PRIMITIVE basis every nonnegative selection vector is feasible. Frobenius positivity excludes nothing from the nonnegative orthant at k = 3

assertions.name: so_feasibility_is_LOOSE_matching_the_corpus_84_and_refuting_my_2_of_8
assertions.source: ilp-solution-count-unwrap.md reports the proton's 9-crossing element admits N_l = 84 FEASIBLE ILP solutions -- a large number, because the constraint is weak, exactly as the diagonal-nonnegative G predicts. qbeta_nucleon_selection_rule_probe found 0/8 feasible at k=1 and 2/8 at k=2 and therefore contradicted categorical-proton-properties.md. That tightness came from testing positivity of the NORMAL-FORM coefficients instead of G x in the primitive basis. The corpus was right; the basis was wrong

assertions.name: the_BINDING_constraint_is_integrality_and_decomposition_not_Gx_geq_0
assertions.source: with G entrywise nonnegative the positivity constraint is vacuous on the nonnegative orthant, so all the content of def:stable-atom sits in what a relaxation drops: that x be the primitive-basis decomposition of the GIVEN T_w with nonnegative INTEGER coordinates. QOU.ParticleInteractions.stableAt_trivial proves the relaxed predicate holds for EVERY G, which is the same statement in Lean. So a formalisation or probe that omits the decomposition constraint decides nothing about stability

assertions.name: the_looseness_SURVIVES_the_filtration_despite_OFF_DIAGONAL_entries
assertions.source: over the k <= 2 basis the Gram matrix is NOT diagonal -- 4 nonzero off-diagonal entries, since an H_2 idempotent is not orthogonal to the H_1 identity -- and yet it is still entrywise nonnegative (0 negative entries). So the k=3 result above is not an artifact of diagonality: the hypothesis of frobPos_of_entriesNonneg survives genuine off-diagonal structure, and Frobenius positivity stays loose across the filtration to k <= 2. This closes the scope caveat the k=3 computation left open

description: The H_3 Frobenius Gram matrix of the primitive Wedderburn-block operators is diagonal with nonnegative entries under convention D, so Frobenius positivity is a LOOSE constraint -- matching the corpus's own count of 84 feasible ILP solutions, and refuting the tightness a sibling probe found by using the wrong basis.

data.scope: (a) measured at k=3 and k<=2 filtration; general k not proved
